final_text: ROOT CAUSE: In [app/mcp_stdio.py](/home/kesha/bench895/runs/A-O3-luna/app/mcp_stdio.py:1842), `get_worker_logs()` calls `/api/sessions/{name}/logs` with `after_id=0`, then slices the returned list to `limit`. The endpoint [get_session_logs()](/home/kesha/bench895/runs/A-O3-luna/app/routes/sessions.py:732) ignores its `limit` parameter on that path and calls `get_logs(session_id, after_id=0)` without a limit. In [app/db.py](/home/kesha/bench895/runs/A-O3-luna/app/db.py:1286), that defaults to 5,000 rows and includes full log content. So the API transfers and decodes up to 5,000 entries before MCP keeps only the last 20.
